debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-o-s-e-d the i-n-i-t-i-a-l c-o-n-t-a-c-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s to b-u-i-l-d t-r-u-s-t, w-h-i-c-h r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a c-u-r-r-e-n-t n-e-t-w-o-r-k p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m s-e-t-t-i-n-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-t-a-t-i-c p-e-r-s-o-n-a t-e-x-t a-s the p-r-i-m-a-r-y t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d the r-e-a-l i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l w-a-s b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
2) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d the e-m-o-t-i-o-n-a-l a-t-t-a-c-h-m-e-n-t w-i-n-d-o-w for e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g t-i-m-i-n-g a-l-i-g-n-m-e-n-t w-i-t-h v-i-c-t-i-m d-u-r-e-s-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-s the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d the f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n a-l-e-r-t c-o-n-t-r-o-l w-a-s b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
3) the a-c-t-o-r d-i-r-e-c-t-e-d r-e-c-i-p-i-e-n-t-s to a-c-t a-s m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s for f-u-n-d s-c-a-t-t-e-r-i-n-g, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g a-c-c-e-s-s to m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e b-a-n-k a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-l-e-a-r l-a-y-e-r-e-d t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n p-a-t-h-w-a-y-s a-s the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d the k-n-o-w n-e-t-w-o-r-k c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l w-a-s b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
4) the a-c-t-o-r i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d a n-o-t-e k-e-p-i-n-g p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l to p-r-e-v-e-n-t v-i-c-t-i-m c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-i-o-n, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g i-n-d-i-v-i-d-u-a-l i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n o-f c-h-a-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-p-l-i-t c-o-n-v-e-r-s-a-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s a-s the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d the s-h-a-r-e-d a-l-e-r-t n-e-t-w-o-r-k w-a-s b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n-e-d t-h-e c-l-o-s-e-d c-a-s-e r-e-c-o-r-d for o-b-s-c-u-r-i-n-g p-u-r-p-o-s-e-s, r-e-q-u-i-r-i-n-g a-c-c-e-s-s to the i-c-c f-i-l-i-n-g s-y-s-t-e-m, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-e-a-l-e-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t a-s the t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d the r-e-c-o-r-d i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t w-a-s b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
